title: Global three-dimensional subsonic Euler flows past an axisymmetric obstacle with large vorticity
summary: In this paper, we prove the existence and uniqueness of subsonic solutions to the steady Euler flows past a smooth, axisymmetric obstacle. Specifically, for a broad class of prescribed positive axial velocities in the upstream, the subsonic Euler flow exists provided that the upstream density exceeds a critical threshold. The non-degeneracy of the axial velocity is rigorously established by combining the strong maximum principle with a refined continuity argument.
